stat_growth_formula.description: HP/ATK/DEF: Base * (1 + (Level-1) * 0.008 * RarityRate) + EvolBonus. SPD/CRATE/CDMG/etc only get evolution bonuses.
stat_growth_formula.note: RarityRate: 1 star 2.0, 2 star 1.9, 3 star 1.8, 4 star 1.7, 5 star 1.7 (StatusRateByLevel); growth scalar 0.008 = StatusRateByGrade 0.8 / 100. Rebalanced 2026-09.
